record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: ODDISH, GLOOM and VILEPLUME (the queued units, the whole line).
record.summary: Area attack around the current target: every enemy on the target's cell or on one of the (up to 8) cells around it is paralysed for a requested 5000 ms and then takes special damage (15 raw at 1 star, 30 at 2, 60 at 3). The paralysis is applied before the damage, per enemy, and is not AP-scaled.

targeting.who: every enemy of the caster in the 3x3 block centred on the current target (the target included)

geometry.shape: 3x3 square centred on the target's cell (getAdjacentCells with includesCenter = true), off-board cells dropped
geometry.origin: the target's cell, not the caster's

effects.scaling: requested amount, per enemy hit: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); crit multiplier only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT; canCritByDefault is false); one crit roll shared by all enemies hit
effects.resolution: applied amount per enemy: the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), min 1) and later handleDamage modifiers; protect / skydiving / magicBounce block the hit for that enemy (its paralysis was already applied). takenDamage (includes shield damage) is not used

declaredRaw.note: requested, same for every star count

statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit: the strategy leaves apBoost at its default false, so triggerParalysis does not multiply by (1 + AP/100)
statusEffects.applicationOrder: per enemy, before that enemy's damage call
statusEffects.guards: not applied with runeProtect or IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS; STORM weather multiplies the duration by 1.3, then by (1 - 0.2 x ELECTRIC_QUARTZ count of the target's player) if any; then the target's applyStatusDurationReductions (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, HYDRATION x0.5, WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, ODD_KEYSTONE -10% each, as recorded in ZAP_CANNON). Timer rule: the cooldown is replaced only if the new duration is larger; the flag is set before that. A CHERI_BERRY holder eats the berry after a successful application
statusEffects.combatEffect: a paralysed unit uses half speed for its attack cooldown and its movement speed and cannot dodge basic attacks. Other uses of status.paralysis (bug-buzz, force-palm, zing-zap, synergies.ts, passives.ts) were seen in sibling records but not read here

starBehavior.note: damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars (pokemon.stars - 1); the 4-star entry 120 and the fallback 120 are not reached by these units' bare star counts (1, 2, 3). Paralysis duration has no star dependence. maxPP is 80 and range 1 for all three.

record.positionalConditions: The block is centred on the target, not the caster; allies and empty cells are skipped. The cell contents are read when the list is built, before any paralysis or damage is applied.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state is kept: each cast re-applies a paralysis whose timer only extends if longer. No modes.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested (raw) damage per enemy: 15 (ODDISH) / 30 (GLOOM) / 60 (VILEPLUME). Applied damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then the SPE_DEF division and later handleDamage modifiers (min 1); takenDamage is not used. Requested paralysis 5000 ms; applied: x1.3 in STORM (less 20% per ELECTRIC_QUARTZ), status-duration reductions, none under runeProtect / IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS, timer only changes if longer.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read
Target selection and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, canCast, range, movement)
Crit chance resolution (only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read)
unresolved: Behaviour when an enemy in the block dies or is moved during the iteration (death handling) was not traced
Whether any other item or synergy effect changes STUN_SPORE

Consulted: Board.getAdjacentCells, Status.triggerParalysis / updateParalysis / applyStatusDurationReductions, handleSpecialDamage, PokemonState.handleDamage and the sibling ZAP_CANNON record. Queue record lists no routing uncertainties and no dependencies.
